title: parley receipt head
description: First line of a receipt file. Carries what the bootstrap line deliberately omitted, so stdout stays small while the record stays complete.

seq.description: The run's single counter continues from the bootstrap line, which is seq 0 (spec §1.3).

run.description: The execution this line belongs to (spec §2.1). ULID or equivalent: unique per execution and lexicographically sortable.

tool.description: The program that wrote this receipt, so a receipt read alone says what produced it (spec §5).

v.description: That program's own version; with tool, a component of the inv preimage (spec §2.2) that a receipt read alone must carry.

inv.description: Content-addressed identity of the question (spec §2.2); never includes a declared secret.

argv.description: As received, after §5.3 redaction: a declared secret appears as the literal [redacted].

resolved.description: After defaults, environment and path resolution. The gap between this and argv is where bugs live.

inputs.description: Every declared input, digested by content. inv is computed over these bytes, never over paths.

version.description: Any 2.x.y: a reader validates every line of the major it was built against and ignores fields it does not know (spec §4.5).

redacted.description: Present and non-empty whenever a declared secret was supplied to the run; absent otherwise (spec §5.3). Lists where the head carries a replaced value.

env.description: Names of declared environment variables that were present.

inputs.description: Indexes into inputs whose path carried a replaced value.
